instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the existing landing page completely from off-white/blue to black metallic with gold/amber luxury styling.
Ensure all text remains crisp and highly legible (use bright white/gold text on deep black surfaces with APCA contrast > 4.5:1).
Incorporate the problem -> solution -> offer copywriting methodology in every text block.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, form fields, cards, nav items, and interactive components.
Use Framer Motion or smooth Tailwind micro-interactions for card hovers, tab switches, and accordion toggles.
Keep standard Stripe payment buttons mocked/prepared while connecting CTAs to scroll smoothly to the Order Enquiry Form section.
Include the required Google Non-Affiliation Disclaimer prominently in the footer.
